column1: # Measure gates for cpl3_4_line (validation-manifest contract: measures).
# Why measures: ngspice-46's own answers on this deck are not
# grid-stable anywhere outside the switching edges. Measured oracle
# self-movement under 2-4x tmax refinement of the windowed means that a
# level gate would use: v(2) mean over [24n,30n] moves -576 mV (4.99 V
# -> 4.42 V), v(9) mean over [24n,30n] moves +176 mV, v(2) mean over
# [44n,50n] decays from +47 mV to +3.6 mV, v(7) mean over [44n,50n]
# from -38 mV to -2.6 mV. No honest level tolerance exists inside a
# family that scatters wider than the quantity itself, so this deck
# gates on the grid-stable engineering content: driver edge timing and
# coupled-line peak amplitudes. RSpice's values sit inside the oracle's
# own scatter on every windowed mean above.
# Source: VS1 PWL 0->5 V at 15.9-16.1 ns, 5->0 V at 31.9-32.1 ns.
# v(2) = driven line input; v(7), v(9) = coupled-line far ends
# (0.24-0.34 V scale). Peak tolerance 12 percent matches the pointwise
# envelope these signals already met.
